principle: Prototype structure, engine and connectors first; integrate and test afterward. 100x is an ambition, not a measured claim.

items.title: Managed product roadmap
items.work: Existing specification has requirements and decisions; add milestones, outcomes, dependencies, linked requirements and agent-context export.
items.dependsOn: Specification revision → roadmap DAG → approved implementation context

items.title: Evidence-led product strategy
items.work: Document extraction and source links exist. Add competitive research, target customer, problem hypotheses, opportunity sizing and assumption tracking.

items.title: Adaptive planning and amendment impact
items.work: Versioned amendments and stale-context handling exist. Join requirement changes to roadmap, wireframes, tasks, deployment and GTM impacts.

items.title: Visual wireframes as the shared design contract
items.work: Editable scenes and approval binding exist. Add explicit text-only vs visual design state, responsive flows, interaction coverage and generated design iterations.

items.title: Reusable design systems and visual implementation guidance
items.work: Carry approved components, tokens, assets, accessibility requirements and frame references into each agent task; support versioned design-system reuse.

items.title: Versioned skill registry and assignment
items.work: Existing context snapshots and team standards are not a skill registry. Add skill ID/version/digest/provenance, role matching, context budgets and task-bound selection.

items.title: Orchestrator decomposition and replanning
items.work: Model advice plus durable coordinator already exist. Add outcome-driven plans with specialist roles, write ownership, dependencies and event-triggered replanning; reuse existing execution engine.

items.title: Parallel teams that integrate their work
items.work: Scheduler, reservations, workspaces, messages, review, repair and integration exist. Close provider event/continuation gaps and prevent duplicated or conflicting work.

items.title: Harness connectors with consistent event contracts
items.work: Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode connections exist. Normalize sessions, streaming output, tool approvals, checkpoints, interruption and resumed work behind existing adapters.

items.title: Cloud swarm placement and lifecycle
items.work: Azure foundation/microVM source exists. Complete per-agent ownership, elastic placement, quota/backpressure, retained artifacts and host-loss reconciliation.

items.title: Independent review and repair loop
items.work: Review/check-repair/integration continuation already implemented. Make it visible and reliable as ordinary work, with defect-specific repair and bounded retries.

items.title: One causal attention queue across projects
items.work: Home and priority/fair scheduling exist. Add ranked interventions showing why work is blocked, what it affects, and the exact next action; integrate existing Home.

items.title: Portfolio goal and capacity management
items.work: Build on existing global/per-project slots and priority aging. Add goals, deadlines, resource budgets, dependencies across projects and project-level allocation explanations.

items.title: Persistent personal Luci across projects
items.work: Project-scoped conversation and coordination exist. Add coherent personal briefing, cross-project intent routing and project-specific context boundaries.

items.title: Typed deployment blueprint and manifest compiler
items.work: Existing VM/Coolify/Pages execution remains. Add app/inference/telemetry topology, dependency graph, connector contracts and generated Kubernetes manifests without applying them.

items.title: Managed bring-your-own infrastructure connectors
items.work: Connect blueprint to existing Azure provisioning, then cluster lifecycle, registry, DNS/TLS, secret references, storage and quotas. AWS follows Azure.

items.title: Inference as a project service
items.work: Keep managed local development inference separate from customer production inference. Add model/image/resource selection, serving configuration, health and scaling.

items.title: Operational telemetry and product analytics
items.work: OTel traces/metrics/logs and customer product events are different needs. Add deployment instrumentation plus a product-event schema, destinations and dashboards.

items.title: Continuous preview, release and recovery
items.work: Commit-bound deployment and rollback source exists. Connect branch previews, promotion, release observations and safe recovery; distinguish code rollback from data restore.

items.title: Structured go-to-market workspace
items.work: Evidence-linked draft documents exist. Add editable customer segment, positioning, competitors, offer, pricing assumptions, channels and launch milestones as versioned records.

items.title: Commercial models and launch assets
items.work: Add explicit price/cost/currency/unit economics, pricing experiments, website/campaign/sales/support assets and project-linked publishing drafts.

items.title: Launch connectors and feedback loop
items.work: Add approved channel publishing and analytics/revenue imports; translate findings into roadmap changes. No unsolicited outreach or automatic ad spending.

items.title: Reusable solutions through Glasses
items.work: Existing Glasses integration/catalogue is the starting point. Add task-level reuse recommendations with licences, provenance and compatibility decisions.

items.title: Memory, checkpoints and restart continuity
items.work: Reuse durable snapshots/events rather than accumulating chat history. Add concise role-specific context refresh, decision summaries and recovery across project sessions.

items.title: Outcome and coordination feedback
items.work: Record useful work completed, waiting time, rework, review load, cost and human decisions. Do not equate tokens, agents or lines of code with customer value.

items.title: Integrated prototype, then representative testing
items.work: First join the new structures to the actual app; then run focused tests and representative multi-project journeys. A CLI toy task is not a prerequisite for source implementation.
